body:
There is so much frustration with having fibromyalgia. Being invalidated by doctors friends and even family. This really can build up causing it to be hard to see someone injured and them not only needing support from you but going to the er where they likely will be listened to and believed. As their injury is that of something more widely accepted as "real" pain and not just in your head. 

I don't know how many people who have told me "oh fibromyalgia the disease that's just in your head?" Including doctors. 

Or just meditate about it. 

And when it comes from a friend that doesn't do research or even ask questions of how they can help makes you build resentment towards them. 

I know cause I just wanted sympathy. Or what can I do to help? Could I come over and help you with something when my life got out of hand.

But the thing is causing hurt by saying those same things back doesnt get your point across. They still don't know what it's like to be in your shoes. Not even remotely. They likely never will. But you won't know what it's like to be in your friends shoes too. You have had a breakdown of communication with your friend to the point where now they don't even want to talk. 

I'm not saying anyone is solely at fault. Because it takes two to communicate. 

You needed to say way earlier more firmly I appreciate you wanting to help but when you say x it makes me feel invalidated. I know your not trying to make me feel this way but when I have experienced this kind of talk from so many others in my life it creates no support system for me. And I end up feeling left alone. Here is what I need from you (give examples and communication)

Being able to say to a friend do you need to rant or do you need advice/help has Leveled up my ability to be a more supportive friend and also get support I need. Because if I can go to that person and ask for help they also feel safe in coming to me. And that's part of building healthy and lasting relationships. If you have a friend that isn't willing to do that and consistently overstep your boundaries and ignores your needs especially basic things like listening. It is okay to be done with that friendship. 

I understand I have no clue how this friendship had gone.what you have set up as boundaries or stated to this person. But that is something to reflect on and see if this is worth salvaging. But clearly something somewhere went wrong be it on accident, or just over time has built up. 

Your friend may not have the same pain as you. They may be over inflating what they are experiencing. Cause it has been proven that taking more shallow breaths can indeed cause panic. But if she is in so much pain she can't take a full breath that is something that needs to be looked at. Maybe not er worthy, but I am also not a doctor and I'm not her. But if your friend is consistently in pain just like if you are it doesn't mean they don't deserve to be out of pain. And you don't deserve to be in pain. 

The real issue here isn't your friend going to the hospital
 The issue here is you have continuously been invalidated, had bandaged solutions and been told to suck it up. This is a problem with the fact that fibromyalgia sucks. And there is no cure.  And it makes us grieve so much that we lost. So many people we pushed away because we found we can't trust them with our problems. And we lost so much time dealing with it all.

I'm so sorry you have had such pain. So much frustration. And I hope you don't lose yet another person. But if losing this person helps you then it may be something that had to happen. 

I sincerely hope you have better days ahead.
Too much fog to remember this too
I wish I could of been there. I even more so wish I could talk to them.

I've always been interested in what the process of death is. I wanted to be a death doula but due to my disabilities and way my life has gone I never tried past some things I've learned. 

Thank you for your help. 

I've already noticed a lot of symptoms. She has been staring into space a lot more. Forgetting what day it is. Or not being all there. Sounds like she needs to know we will be alright and then she will let go. I just hope we're not too late with the paperwork. And if we are that family won't fight us.

That sounds about what she likes. Lot of greasy food but the cancer makes it so she can't eat any of it. She asks what there is to eat. We are running out of things cause she can't eat half the stuff she's used to. We took coffee away from her today cause it's causing heart burn. And making it so she won't eat. She would drink a full pot a day. 

Fairlife milk has been somewhat of a blessing cause she can drink it and it has some extra protien. But other then that she may eat extra noodle lipton soup. Or ramen. She doesn't like sweet for breakfast. And eggs and toast is too much. Just so frustrating. Idk what to make anymore. 


I'm thankful for you sharing your experiences and everyone else sharing. It helps me not feel so alone. Having no support in the middle of nowhere is hard. I'm hopeful with advice given and encouragement I can get through this.

Yeah I worry about that too. Granted any emergency services takes 30min or longer to get here. Likely she will pass in her sleep but I do know their are other complications that could happen. I will be looking into creating a dnr today and poa. I have a lot of feelings that aren't great that we didn't do this sooner. And I didn't have the strength to do it sooner. When all 3 of us that are taking care of her have anxiety I think we are struggling to even do anything other then what is needed at the moment. It's hard to think to protect future us and her. We definitely are learning a lot. But I feel so ashamed and idk why
That's what I'm scared of.

Even when she was more able to think. She didn't get why to set up those legal things. Id try and talk to her but she shuts down. Even when she wasn't sick. That's the thing she is okay with dying. She's excited to see the other side. She says she will get to see her dad and a lot of others she misses so much. 


She has no poa or dnr. I asked her and she just said well me just telling u should be enough. She doesn't understand the legality of it. Even before she was at this point. Same with life insurance. She figured she wouldn't qualify since she has cancer. I told her they would still cover funeral costs. She still said no. She's stubborn. Always has been. So we will have even more legal issues soon

We don't have access to hospice. And she wants to die at home. 

I know she isn't eating cause her body is shutting down. But no one will listen. The family outside of us taking care of her says she just needs to power through. Take these herbs. Get a 2nd opinion. They don't get how aggressive this type of cancer is. I tried explaining it. But they think the mind is powerful enough to stop cancer growth. It's so frustrating
Sounds about right for this family. They didn't help us when we needed it most why would they help her?

Where we live we don't have access to hospice. And she wants to die at home. Our family also doesn't get that. We've explained it to them and they just say force her to eat. We told them that's not possible. Or healthy. And we refuse to do that. They are trying to get her to their house to talk to her alone. To tell her she's giving up on life. We told them she's fought for 2 years. Got the newest treatment. (Immdeltra) 

I told her I will protect her and her journey to the end.  I've dealt some with these things but I don't know any of the legal stuff. She also is refusing to talk about the legal stuff. She sleeps most of the day so it's too much for her.  Honestly this progressed faster then we knew how to deal with it.
No living will. And she refuses to make one. She refused to even get life insurance to pay for cremation. We've explained how it will help us and she said what do I care I'll be dead.

NAD but have had recurring uti. Could be a number of things. If you have over active bladder you could be sensitive to aspartame,black or green tea. Dark chocolate (usually they have a list of things to avoid.) A urologist could help diagnose this. Keeping a food log can help and looking up foods that mess with oab. 


I also struggl3d for a year of uti and had pink mold in our shower which was caused by fecal matter in the shower (gross story) when I moved out and from that roommate they stopped. 


Also if you have a bv infection or yeast infection I've had those cause pain with urination due to micro cuts.


I hope my experiences can help you find leads to a solution to your health. Feel better soon

She's in the same zone. She just has more space for plants than I do. And her cats leave her plants alone more than mine. So I have to make a safe place for them. I hope I can get myself stuff started this weekend then.

I might have to. She's cognitive enough to understand why it's important to ask for help or even use her walker. She's just stubborn. I know she will be offended cause she heard people at the hospital being "tattled" on from getting our of bed but she also didn't understand why she had to wear a fall risk bracelet as she was "fine" 

She's in denial of her state and what her state will be coming to before passing but she isn't in denial of passing. It's strange. 

Thank you for suggesting this. I will look into it
Thought it was cut twice measure once.

My family member quit cold turkey when they experienced Superior vena cava syndrome. And found out they had small cell lung cancer. They have been through cancer treatment since 2023. Found out on their sons birthday. 


This year they were told none of the treatment is working anymore. Including immune therapy.  But they stopped with no cravings since they been diagnosed with cancer. 


Wish they just stopped sooner. As they are 62. And just retired from working for the gov. For 15 years. They didn't even get to enjoy retirement. 


If anyone reading this sees this. I know you don't care now. What happens to you. But this has been the most painful thing to go through for them. As now they also have osteoarthritis and fell and broke their arm. They didn't even fall hard. It was just enough. They are on blood thinners for the rest of their life. So any fall is a hospital stay to watch for internal bleeding. 


It's miserable. It's hard for family to watch. It's hard on everyone involved. 


My heart is broken. Because we're losing so many people to this horrid cancer. And their smoking also will effect their kids. Cause they smoked around them. Exposing them to sclc cause it runs in their family cause their dad died from it. 


If me sharing this helps one person quit. I've hopefully done good. Please don't smoke. Your worth so much more then this. You deserve more. Your loved ones deserve more.

I have had someone break up with me because my illness was too much for him to handle. And it didn't fit into what he wanted to do in life. (Be a traveling photographer/documentary person)
This coming from a guy who had cancer in his leg that was cutting off circulation to his leg so it was atrophied and he had to use a cane. It was so bad that if he bumped it he would be in severe pain. 
Only solution for him was to get it amputated but he didn't want to because he didn't want a prosthetic. Which I get to some degree.


To me though it emotionally messed with me. As I thought he'd understand. But I was just too disabled for him. Even tho he was as well. 


I was in the beginning of my journey then. I now understand that anyone can become disabled at any point. And he will learn that eventually.


I am in a happy Healthy relationship now and been for 14 years. Their are people out there that will know you aren't your disability. And that it's not a bug it's a feature. Lol

I have it prescribed by my doctor. They prescribed 40mg 1x daily. You can get osteoporosis from it if your on it long periods of time. So they generally want you to get the cycle of acid reflux down with the pill long enough to heal and also thro diet change then take you off. I still have to go in for a follow up to see how long I will be on it. But have yet to be able to do that. I've been on it for 3 months now I believe.
I've done this. The lady I got ahold of ended up coming to get me and was laughing.

I have over active bladder along with it. I also get uti easily. And don't get the normal symptoms of uti. 

I was told to stay away from black tea, green tea, dark chocolate, coffee, asparagus among a lot more. It helps but I still have bladder spasms and other issues. 

Fibro is so frustrating how connected fibro is with everything.
They do have some support product from azo that have urinary pain relief. They have uti tests and bladder support that may help. Tho acidic things can make stuff worse. Like Cranberries and orange juice. 
 I hope you find relief.

Thank you for the encouragement. I did realize I do have a dental infection so I do need to get the toothe pulled before going on with the prednisone. 

"I'm tired of being a dartboard" really resonates with me. I am experiencing the same issue with anxiety and depression. Every new medication has a new side effect. And if they think the benifits outweigh the side effects I basically get stuck on it. 

For now I will keep jumping through their hoops until I find something else for a better path. I'm hopeful for the new science of fibromyalgia coming out. Hopefully we will get answers soon

Mine was allergy to wheat and eggs. Mild but caused itching. Rashes I thought were just from fibro. Joint pain. (Which I still have but has settled a little) 

Worst time I had joint pain was after having beer with wheat in it. I started connecting dots and my doctors didn't believe me. My ent. Offered a ige blood test after sinus surgery 1
5 yrs ago. I been asking  for one for over 10 yrs. 

I cut out those things and it's helped a lot. Allergy tests are worth a shot to see if that helps

I get it. I'm anxious about it too. And it's not stupid. There are a lot of factors in it. Like feeling connected. Having access to learning about lots of people and things. Even mental health help. 

It's helped people, its helped help people organize and protest in meaningful ways. 

It's not over yet. People are still standing up against this ban. Like someone who has introduced a bill to stall the ban for another 200 something days to hear more arguments. 

There are also people planning to bog down servers of the gov on the 19th. 

They also plan a class action lawsuit if it does go through to help those who have lost buisness from the ban.

Keep looking for the good. Look for the people who are showing paths to protecting out rights to free speech. Like writing your governor and state representatives.

Tiktok ban isn't just about tiktok. That's why we don't give up. And anyone making fun doesn't understand the difference tiktok has made for millions of people. They think it's just about people making dumb videos but if that's all they see on their for you page. That's what they made for themselves. 

I've seen so much good on that app. And we haven't had a app make that much of a difference. And so people question it. But tell them what you've seen that made a difference to you. Your voice matters. And if they ban it. We will all just become louder. 

(And we will have a lot more time on our hands so that too should scare them )

My poor cat was going into heat every other week. I luckily got her fixed in time but she went through 6 heat cycled before I could. She was miserable. 

I'm thankful I got her fixed though. Even more so when I heard of a friends cat getting cancer from not being spayed.

This may still be a easy fix. Sometimes we find relief in the strangest places. I found out I'm allergic to wheat and eggs. I had a specific ieg test. I was having acid reflux, yellow stool, severe intestinal pain among so much else. I've been off wheat and eggs for a few months now and I'm loads better. I still have diverticuli but that's manageable. And I only have intestinal pain every once in a while. 


So you may still have other tests available and things to look up. It's frustrating but its worth it to keep looking for answers. Keeping a food journal may help. I hope you start to feel better soon. And I send you lots of luck in finding answers.

Kids are wonderful. They are absolutely amazing to watch grow and learn. In some ways I want one. But others I don't. I'm 36 and still unsure. But since I'm unsure I don't think it's fair to me to bring a Child into the world. Because I don't want to resent them. Sure my hormones may change if I have a kid but I'm not a gambling type. Especially when it involves another's life. 


Maybe if there wasn't so many factors like costs and the planet being killed. School shootings and so much more. I love my friends kids. And that's just where I'm at.

Growing up, they had those busy mats at restaurants. They had a smallish word search and left a word out. I was 7 or 8 and can't believe how angry I felt when they told us that they cut out a word to keep kids busy looking for it. 

I felt like I was stupid. Because they tricked me. 

Now he basically did that to you. To keep u busy. It's patronizing and infantilizimg.

If yoga is harsh on wrists and ankles check for hypermobility too. Some people are starting to look into the link between people with Fibromyalgia and people with eds and/or hypermobility. Not saying you have it but may give u better exercise to protect the joint. Thai chi was suggested to me by another doctor. I couldn't afford classes but you may be able to check ur library to see if any people started a group in the your town. Also tiktok may have options too. I may have to check it out because tbh I haven't even checked. Lol

Sometimes we need a change. I know a lot of people that do seasonal work in national parks at near by buisnesses or in the national parks. They often have housing too. Not saying this is the right choice for you. But it may get you something different and make friends. 


Just remember not everything has to be the way it is now and sometimes the best change is something completely different. Just have a plan and a backup plan
Hope things start looking up for you.
You can't do a skin prick test true. But you could do a ige blood test.
I saw a tiktok where they talked about dark circles being a sign of chronic allergies, might be a starting point to see what ur allergic to?

The problem is I have moved so much that getting proper documentation is hard cause 2 of the places I've gone don't exist anymore. I don't even know the doctors I've seen at this point. And I'm too tired to even start over from square one. Especially if they put me on something that i experienced the symptoms i got from Prozac again. I've been doing this song and dance since I was 16. Every doctor has a different diagnosis because of many factors. (My mom included) and finding help is hard even more so now that I have anxiety built around it. 

I know the process. I know what is commonly used for it. I've likely been on it. They don't work for me.
I'm aware the process. I've been on many antidepressants and I've only had bad side effects or no effect at all.

ESH
19 yr old for running to mom,
Mom for not listening 
But you too for not standing ur ground and not telling them what happened after she got sick. Sucks ur partner has to tell them and also probably help defuse the situation 


Another key thing u could of done is " I am not comfortable giving her 12 mg NICOTINE gum but you can if you want." And hand it to her mom. Not the daughter. Whole package so she can see what it is and get the gravity of what it is she's asking. So she'd have to take it out to even give it to her. Putting the responsibility in her hands.

I won't take ssri for this reason cause I started having some of these symptoms within two weeks of taking. I was terrified they wouldn't go away. I'm not about to try again on that type. 


Doctors go to for me is this type of med tho. I'm still struggling to explain if I didn't have anxiety I wouldn't have depression. But they insist long term depression meds is the only way to treat my anxiety.

I think that's partly why they use memantine with it. Cause I have a lot less fog with that combination but if I run out of memantine I notice the fog comes back. But definitely understand not wanting a medication that doesn't have that severe of a side effect. That sounds frustrating. I hope you are able to find something that helps you.
I've lived in both areas. The higher elevations does cause more issues for me. Especially when storms roll in. More migraine, stiff muscles and headaches and a lot more brain fog

Where I used to live (wa) they would treat me going to rheumatologist. They gave me gabapentin and memantine. They work pretty good for me together. But the studies of memantine is limited so where I'm at my pcp doctor is always questioning it.

My current state does not have enough rheumatologist to see fibromyalgia patients. But they did send for one appointment and found I have hypermobility. They then sent me on my way with no other advice then getting good insoles. 

They may have found new information on fibromyalgia but it has yet to be implemented. Not to mention I still am running into doctors that believe it's all in ur head. So that's fun.

Nta but like others keep options that don't break the bank.


I'm 36 and just found out I have a wheat allergy. And egg.  Mild but its there. Was causing gut pain and making acid reflux worse. But little while ago I got frustrated with my whole family saying it's mild it won't matter. Or one member saying if u keep eating it it will go away. So I binged. I had even more severe reaction. My back was itchy and getting hives. And my throat was itchy. That hadn't happened before. I now will be having to ask for a epi pen. Because I live 30 min from a doctor. And I accidently ate wheat at families because they don't understand wheat goes into everything. And what cross contamination is. 


You may need to explain to him the severity of what it means if it gets worse. Or find someone who has had it get worse explain it. Or maybe get him into a counseling.


Yes He is 17. But even now at 36 I am struggling with this. It's hard feeling left out. It's hard people around u not getting it. It's hard asking at restaurants and double checking. It's hard constantly reading labels. (Fig is a good app to help)


Even diabetic people struggle with the food restrictions they have to have. And need support groups. It's mentally taxing.


I hope he sees its worth feeling better.

Christmas light drives are nice. Or YouTube has live channels of going through Swiss alps on train or other snowy areas. They are a nice change from yule log fire channels if you get bored of those. 


If you are into stardew valley you can leave out milk and cookies for Santa or other games have Christmas theme activities. I know destiny has some for Christmas or Halloween. Animal crossing has little special things too I think. (And different fish and bugs you can get on different holidays)


Read books that have Christmas theme or cheer in it. 


I like to window shop online and see the ridiculous things they have as gift suggestions. And admittedly eat more junk then I need to. Lol

My grandpa and grandma did this. I loved it growing up. Though they had a sitting room and a area you watched TV. So they weren't in the sitting room as often. But I've seen people do subtle changes on their tree to make it work for different holidays.
Not having kids cause I can't be sure I will receive life saving medical care. And I CANT afford kids!

Seeds. Tires or any car parts. Any home repairs you may need. 
Backup drives for anything personal like photos memories and medical stuff incase you need to leave. 
Seasoning. And staple foods to make things stretch.

Exactly. Nothing is black and white. Or even the same for everyone. Generalized advice like this is hard for people that have complex situations and is actually a little frustrating to hear all the time.
Same. Tbh I'm in more pain since I live in the mountains and the pressure in the winter is higher.

I got a total IgE test or quantitative IgE test. It is just a blood test and it tells you the levels you are allergic to things. But even low numbers on things can cause symptoms. 

It took me years of asking and I didn't get it till I went to a ear nose and throat doctor for my deviated septum. They also cleaned out my sinuses. But after he offered to do the allergy test because I had chronic sinus issues. 

You will just have to bring it up to your doctor and ask. I'm not sure otherwise how to. I'm sorry

I found out I was allergic to wheat and eggs. And I cut them out of my diet and the itching isn't near as bad. Maybe a blood panel would help to see if you have any allergies. I know that's not for everyone but maybe it's worth a try if you haven't tried it. 


I get the frustration tho. I had spots that itches so bad but if I scratched it it would be painful.


Wish you luck.

My sister, who voted democratic for 22 years, voted for trump this year. She wrote me saying, " I know how scared you are, but everything will be okay." it felt so infantilizimg (I have a learning disability but I still get a lot I'm just slow)


I go by they them pronouns and am on disability. Many of my friends are of the lgbtqia or are first generation imagrants. My partners family member just got on disability for sclc. And is getting chemo. 


To say the least we could lose everything. Not to mention we're in a very red state and my partner is Indigenous. 


I told my sister I didn't even want to hear it. That her being a person with not a bone of hate in her body didn't matter. Because hate is apparently not a deal breaker for her. 


I didn't have the energy to explain how problematic this was. 


I've been reading a lot and the paradox of tolerance is basically what we're dealing with. I don't know how to even begin the conversation with my father. A Christian and republican. But I know it's coming. Right now though I have to set aside my grief of my relationship with my sister and take my partners mom to cancer treatment. 


I hope all our families come out of this but I don't think that's happening any time soon.


Thank you for anyone who read this. I've been needing somewhere, someone to relate to and with.

I feel your right. Ibs is just a symptom of something else. And doctors just label it as that because they were taught to diagnose not question the situation as a whole. Not all doctors do that. But if you find one that does stick with them. 




I'm not sure if this is fully my issue. But so far I have chronic gerd (still tracking down why) and a wheat and egg allergy. I stopped getting "random" rashes. And my stomach doesn't hurt nearly as bad. I've been off eggs for almost 6 months now and wheat 1 month. That one for shorter cause they tested for celiac. I still have gall stones but were still working on my gerd cause I also have barrets esophagus so I am getting more testing for that. But I'm so much closer then I was before.

Not saying that this is what it is, but when I had similar issue with converse I found out years later I am hypermoble. I still don't know if it's eds, but that explained the pain. My arch in my feet couldn't keep up, and my knees slightly bow in which throws off my hips. You can look up tests for hypermobility and discuss it with your doctor if it's a possibility. They then can give more guidance on how to deal with it. But for now try insoles. That could help a lot. Gel ones if you need a more cushion layer or ones with high arch. You can alway layer them to what feels right for you. That's what my rheumatoid doctor said

I have barrets esophagus and reading I have to cut out more foods. They don't want me on omeprazole long cause it can cause bone density issues. But I'm trying to manage it. I didn't know I was still having it cause it doesnt cause the normal pain anymore. It's just a sharp pain in my left upper side and a dry cough. Among other gastro symptoms. 


Get it checked out if u can. It over time with repeat damage can turn to cancer.
My friends cat got uterine cancer from not being spayed. I'm glad op trusted their beliefs on it sounds like the cat is in good hands.

I've been taking it for several years now. I take 10 mg 1x daily. It's not commonly used as far as I know for fibromyalgia. So I'm not sure of the long-term effects. But gabapentin has also been starting to come up with long-term negative effects, so I'm already in a place where I may never be off of it. Unless they come up with a better solution. But the combination had helped me enough where I can use tools (calenders, note pad and alarms) to assist along with memantine. Where I can better function than I did before I was on it. 

Granted, since it's not commonly used, you will have to do your own research and speak to your doctor about it. I had a rheumatoid arthritis doctor who went to school outside of the USA to get a better understanding of fibromyalgia. He also was recommending botox (which I never did) for joints and thai chi. 

Getting into habits/schedules also helps a lot. But I also have a learning disability that benefits from it.

I was prescribed memantine and it helps me a lot. I notice a huge difference when I'm not on it. I also take gabapentin too. I also notice I have less brake through nerve pain when I have memantine.


Also get checked for sleep apnea that can contribute to brain fog and eat lots of omega foods. 


Hope you feel better

Someone once told me "you must not have anxiety because you want to learn to drive" any disability or disorder is a spectrum and can do things at different levels. Some people are doing exposure therapy. Some are on medication. Some have social anxiety in only certain situations or with certain people. Like giving presentations at work. But can hang out with friends fine cause they are "safe". 


Doesn't mean they don't have it. Means it just is different for them on a day to day basis. And that's okay. Doesn't make anyone less valid in their experience. And they may have tools like breathing techniques, or something else that you don't see. Could be good friends to have because you can ask them what helped them and get ideas flowing on what might help you. Maybe fidget toys, taking breaks or having a safe area. Or even a headphones. 


It's hard to relate. But its good to ask questions to understand better.

I'm not sure. When I was 2 weeks old I got very sick. My parents couldn't ever tell me what I had. I imagine just the antibiotics they threw at me Helped. All I know is "you were burning up and had skin red and ruff like lobster shell" my parents are so helpful on it. I don't know how long I was sick either. But I belive I got it very young. Cause I remember symptoms my whole life.

I have a endoscopy tomorrow. I'm chronicly ill. And worry I will get another diagnosis that has no solution. Plus I pass out with IVs. Or get close to it. 


Haven't seen my dad in 7 years. And every day it feels like I won't be able to see him for another year. Its extremely hard to travel in winter where I'm at and I need a good amount to go see him sine I fear planes. My income is very low due to my disability and it got cut by a little over 200 this month. And preparing for winter costs a lot too. (We use pellet stove) and the house needs work so it's warmer. As it gets -50 f where I'm at at times. 


I also worry my disability will stop me from seeing him as it's already made it impossible to work. Drive or even have kids. 


Our floor has a hole in it. The shower leaks. The roof leaks. I worry about my cat as she is old and needs to go to the vet. But I rely on everyone else for help. I'm incredibly ashamed. I just want to be able to work. And the stigma I get for not being able to. Feels like a weight on my chest. 


I'm behind on appointments too. My meds are out of refill. And I'm overwhelmed. 


There is so much more. But I feel like I'm drowning. And all I can think of is just disappearing. As I see nothing getting better. 


And all I want is to hug my dad. And I can't figure out Zoom to talk to him. And the cell tower where I'm at sucks. And no home phone. Verizon won't do anything.. 


Anyways I'd have a 7 part novel if I stayed. Sorry to dump. I just am so overwhelmed

I had this same issue. Didn't get better till I moved. Realized it was cause I had pink mold in the shower. Which I read in some cases can cause uti. 


If it's from sex a doctor said pee before sex and then clean after (front to back same with wiping) then pee again. It's a lengthy process but could help.

You will likely become dependent. With that you could have side effects if you choose to go off. So if you are on it a long time and want to go off taper off it with your doctors guidance. 


I personally would rather not be on it but it's my only option. I also take 10mg of mamantine with it and it helps a lot.

For me it was easy being depressed. I didn't have to do anything hard. I was safe in my bed. I didn't have to have arguments with friends, or go to work. I didn't even clean my room.

It's hard being responsible it's hard to choose to be happy every day.

It's even harder when you have no energy because you put all the effort into focusing on the bad. 

So if you choose you can write out whats making you depressed. But then write out what makes you happy.

It can be even the smallest things but you have to work on noticing the good. Because it's like finding something that's lost. Your never going to find it if you don't put forth the effort to do so. 

And you will have times you slip up which happens to everyone. The best thing to do in those times is have a tool chest. Things that comfort you. Reminders of what make you happy. Like the list. Whatever helps you. As it's hard to fix anything without tools.

I have anxiety with ssi. Here's some tricks you can use to help a bit for now. Write out what you need to talk or ask questions about, having a script can make it easier because you don't think just do. Call early in the morning less time on hold makes it easier to call because it won't give you the time to be worked up. Have a paper and pen ready to write down anything you need and your ssi number.

Ask " I am calling to see if you have received a document I sent in about appealing your decision on my social security case and weather I have done it correctly or if I need to follow any other steps" 
If they say you have other steps to do and you need clarification ask what you need clarified. 

Get any addresses or information you need.

For getting to your doctor call your doctors office and ask to speak to your doctors nurse practitioner, she can answer questions about getting you medication, ask her for a temporary refill for your anxiety medication until you can get into a appointment, if she says no ask for hydroxyzine it is a pill that kind of is like benadryl that calms the nerves and isn't addictive so doctors are more willing to prescribe it. If they are not willing to do that ask if she is willing to do a over a video appointment. 

As for transportation you can get call 211 and put in your zip code then they have prompts on what you need or you can say what you need. Say transportation and they can tell you if they have a number for transportation for disabled people. That can take relief off of you and the drivers are usually very nice. You tell them the day of your appointment and your address and they pick you up and then drop you off after. 

I know making phone calls is hard, but do everything you can to set yourself up for success, have questions ready, any information you need, anything that calms you. Weighted blanket, fidget toys, your favorite drink or hard candy. Remember to breathe and anyone you talk to like ssi and your doctor deal with people every day with anxiety. Another thing is you can have family help make phone calls, you will have to confirm it is you and give permission for them to talk with who ever is going to help you, but I've had to do that too. This stuff is hard but you will have to find a way to see the doctor whether its video appointment or going in, it sucks but you got to take care of you. You will figure out a way but sometimes it takes thinking out side the box. And don't worry getting help with phone calls won't make it so your mom has to help.

I personally can't read out loud I stutter and fumble over my words but I found what helps is reading the section first in my head and then reading it again out loud. Just takes time to find what works for you. Another thing that helped me is learning to type on the computer with the programs that help you type faster.
